result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The `cli` module tests pass, but I didn't run `analyzeLandscape` itself, so no `config.json` or `index.html` was generated by it.

- **`Commands.java`**: added the `analyzeLandscape` name and description (landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as `updateLandscape`). It's listed in the no-argument usage overview next to `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: added a dispatch branch that calls the existing `updateLandscape(...)` handler with the new name and description. So `analyzeLandscape -help` prints its own usage, and `updateLandscape -help` keeps printing its own.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape command" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` and says `updateLandscape` is the same command under its older name.
